checks.stud-calculator: Check end-centerline heights and the separate left/right top cuts of each sloped stud face.
checks.framing-calculator: Compare the measured door/window jamb references with every king, jack, header and sill row before purchasing lumber.
checks.deck-board-calculator: Sum all board face widths and clear gaps, including the last rip, to reproduce the target deck coverage. If the entered board has end trim or reserved saw kerf, physically check each end and compare stock length minus both end trims and kerf against the reported usable length. Multiple stock pieces per row still require a separate verified joist-supported seam plan.
checks.baluster-spacing-calculator: Sum the physical baluster faces and all between-face and end spaces; local safety limits remain independent.
checks.rafter-calculator: Confirm half-ridge deduction, horizontal seat, plumb heel and normal remaining throat use different datums.
checks.crown-molding-calculator: Confirm the corner and spring angle on scrap; the illustration is not a saw-handed cutting instruction.
checks.soffit-calculator: Measure all roof-fall, fascia and lining values from the same wall-rafter datum.
checks.kerf-bending-calculator: Check flat-stock slot start/end positions and remaining continuous web; actual bendability needs a trial.
checks.wainscoting-calculator: Add physical panel faces, all between-panel gaps and both margins to close exactly to wall width.
checks.stair-calculator: Count N risers, N−1 separate treads, and check that the landing is not counted as an extra tread.
checks.rise-run-calculator: Verify the diagonal by hypot(rise, horizontal run); percentage grade divides by horizontal run.
checks.deck-material-calculator: Check board seams against joist center references, and review actual end gaps and unmodeled saw kerf.
checks.segmented-bowl-calculator: Compare straight physical chord lengths, not curved arcs, and distinguish polygon from turned-ring diameter.
checks.roof-pitch-calculator: Select the source ratio, angle, grade or measured rise/run explicitly; hip elevation is a separate angle.
checks.equal-spacing-calculator: Check first/last physical face positions, then verify the chosen integer count yields the reported REAL pitch.
checks.hip-rafter-calculator: Recalculate the horizontal plan diagonal from perpendicular runs before deriving true hip elevation angle.
checks.hip-roof-calculator: Separate sloped cut vertices from plan projections; check used sheet area plus discarded offcuts.
checks.wall-stud-calculator: Deduct the actual upper/lower plate stack from the gross straight-wall height.
checks.shelf-spacing-calculator: Check each shelf top/bottom datum and real support-pin positions, not just the count of shelves.
checks.gable-roof-calculator: Verify two mirrored sloped roof faces from the same half-span and horizontal eave overhang.
checks.square-layout-calculator: Compare both measured diagonals against an independent Pythagorean target; corner positions are not inferred.
checks.diagonal-brace-calculator: Compare the complete diagonal with separately shortened brace X/Y endpoints.
checks.hole-spacing-calculator: Use the same X/Y board edge origin for every hole, and measure clearance to the circular EDGE.
checks.stair-stringer-calculator: Verify finished-floor rise, installed tread thickness, and normal nominal throat independently.
checks.roof-sheathing-calculator: Sum actual eave/uphill cut bounds and verify stock area equals used face area plus offcuts.
checks.fence-post-calculator: Distinguish end POST CENTER run from the outside face-to-face length.
checks.fence-picket-calculator: N actual picket faces produce N+1 equal gaps, including both spaces beside the inside post faces.
checks.gambrel-roof-calculator: The two horizontal runs total the eave-to-ridge half-span, and the two rises total ridge elevation.
checks.lumber-price-calculator: Check which dimensional convention your supplier invoices against: nominal or physically dressed actual measurements. Independently multiply thickness × width × length in inches and divide by 144; compare the board-foot result and the rounded WHOLE board order on the CSV. Recalculate the supplier's BF/MBF rate, tax and any additional shipping manually, without assuming the website checked market prices.
checks.spiral-staircase-calculator: On a scaled drawing, mark the inner and outer column/tread radii from the same true center; independently check each CSV annular wedge vertex with radius and angle, confirm 12×30° closes 360°, and compare rise per station against the finished vertical datum. Do not use the walkline arc as proof of legal tread depth or real headroom.
checks.stave-calculator: Measure the OUTSIDE polygon corner diameters rather than finished round diameter and choose the physical rim vertical height. Independently calculate top/bottom chords with D sin(pi/n), then use a cardboard trapezoid sample to verify its developed face slant and side-edge lengths. Do not transfer the mathematical half-angle directly to a saw blade without an actual scrap fit trial.
